reviews.text: Incredibly kind and friendly owner! Super knowledgeable about the products he sells too. Open on thanksgiving as well!
Met the cutest manager Otis! He greets customers and just wants scratchies ❤️

I’m a dog walker as well as a vegan and a cat mom. Bark & Meow’s owner Charles runs the best pet store I’ve ever been to; something for all. I love being able to buy vegan dog treats, compostable poop bags from local companies and thanks to Charles’ creativity, actually finding food that my fussy cat Lu will eat.

Came by for a quick visit scouting for dog products I wouldnt normally come across in the big name places. Owner is friendly and very willing to offer suggestions and information on the products in the store. Pleasant visit, some unique offerings. Will be back to browse further.
The friendliest service and great recommendations for kitty toys!
dog pee on the walk way, bad smell and disrespectful shopkeeper
Person in the front let me run in last line to buy treats. And such amazing service.
Personal service and they have a good selection of natural flea and tick prevention.

This is a great store for all your vegan dog needs! My girl Nala has allergies to almost everything and stores like this are what keep her alive since big box stores do not carry anything she can consume. Great visit today meeting the owner Charles!

Excellent products and the best vegan offerings at a store in Toronto. The owner Charles carefully curates what he brings in based on a combination of thorough research and first-hand accounts from customers. He truly cares about animals and is very helpful.  His dog Otis is adorable and always ready to give lots of  love to visitors.
Thanks for the 5 stars. See you again soon.  🙂 …

We have been partnered with Bark & Meow Pet Supplies for many years now.
Charles, the owner is so passionate and knowledgeable with his products and care!
I trust him and we always bounce ideas and products off each other. My senior dog was having some old age pain, getting up and such. I spoke with Charles regarding this.
He suggested Hemp 4 Tails. He helped me understand how much to give and what to look for. How it will help my 15 1/2 year old Cattle, Border Collie mix with moving and getting up. Nitro has been taking this amazing wonderful product for a few months now and I can see and feel the difference it gives him. This product has helped my dog in many different ways and I am so grateful and appreciative for Charles help and support with this. Thank You so much again!!
You are the best. Cheers to you and an amazing friendship. 💚🫶🏻
Bought a jacket for my wifes dog and the owner was just super helpful
